en_how: Three.js toon materials with a three-step gradient map give only light, mid and shadow tones, and every object wears an enlarged back-face black shell as its outline; shops with awnings and signs, cherry trees made of icosahedron clusters, utility poles and sagging wires are laid out in code, the sky is a gradient-shaded dome and clouds are outlined sphere clusters; an original girl built from capsules and spheres walks uphill with sine-driven limbs while the camera roams around her, and Canvas adds falling petals, a Japanese title, a quest box, stamina bar and minimap.
